notes.title: 🚂 ALL ABOARD — UPDATED TRAILER ARRIVES!
notes.content:
The Dreadline Express has evolved significantly over the past six months. To give you a sneak peek, we updated the trailer. Take a look at how great it looks!
[previewyoutube="-j0t6KyaRlU;full"][/previewyoutube]
You may notice improved graphics, new NPC characters, additional story elements, redesigned core systems, updated illustrations, and more. However, the sum of all the changes greatly exceeds what you can see.


Farewell generative AI
From day one, the AI-generated art was just a placeholder. And now? It’s outta here.

Enter Krystof—our brilliant new illustrator who has been bringing to life all the bizarre and beautiful ideas I throw his way. The card art has leveled up: more creative, more unified, and delightfully surreal when it needs to be.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/64b0125ebfc3d4d70345855091ef33e5cdf84414.jpg"]

It's finally time to remove the "AI Generated Content Disclosure" from the Steam page.


More steam!
It's not only Krystof. The Dreadline Express team has practically doubled in size over the last six months. Rest assured, I will introduce you the other team members soon. Stay tuned!

In the meantime, please help us gain more steam! Tell your friends, share the trailer, and spread the word—it will help us greatly!



Until next time, the conductor’s watching. Stay curious.


- David
